definition: TabPFN (Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network) is a machine learning model for tabular datasets proposed in 2022.
details: It uses a transformer architecture. It is intended for supervised classification and regression analysis on tabular datasets, particularly focusing on small- to medium-sized datasets. The latest version, TabPFN-3, was released in May 2026 and supports datasets with up to one million rows and 200 features.
